title.narrative: Toward Malaria Elimination - Zambia (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Zambia, Malaria, Churches Health Association of Zambia (CHAZ)This program has the following goals: To eliminate local malaria infection and disease in Zambia by 2021. To maintain malaria-free status and prevent reintroduction and importation of malaria into areas where the disease has been eliminated. The objectives of this program are: Increase the malaria-free health facility catchment areas (HFCAs) from 0.5% in 2015 to 100% in 2021. Reduce malaria incidence from 336 cases per 1,000 population in 2015 to less than 5 cases per 1,000 population by 2021. Increase the implementation rate of interventions from 36% in 2015 to 95% by 2021. Reduce malaria deaths from 15.2 deaths per 100000 in 2015 to less than 5 deaths per 100000 population by 2021
